display.title: Counting Toward the Torah: Sefirah and Pirkei Avos
display.summary_short: Why the days of Sefirah are filled with love for the Torah, and why we learn a chapter of Pirkei Avos every Shabbos between Pesach and Shavuos.
display.summary_long: A short Sefirah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that when the Jewish people left Egypt, their bodies were free, but they waited eagerly for the freedom of their neshamos, which came 49 days later at Har Sinai. They counted the days like a prisoner counting down to his release. Every year during Sefirah we feel that same love for the Torah. One way we show it is by learning a chapter of Pirkei Avos, Ethics of Our Fathers, each Shabbos afternoon after Mincha, finishing all six chapters before Shavuos. Pirkei Avos was chosen because good character must come before Torah: when we behave well and practice good habits, we understand the Torah better and do mitzvos in the finest way. For soldiers in Tzivos Hashem, this means filling up mitzvah charts and rising in rank, showing Hashem we are ready to receive the Torah again on Shavuos.
display.lesson: Get ready to receive the Torah on Shavuos by working on good midos during Sefirah.
